prompts.text: The freight train reached the northern terminal before dawn.
Before sunrise, a cargo rail service arrived at the station in the north.
A small ferry carried twelve passengers across the river.
Twelve travelers crossed the waterway aboard a compact passenger boat.
The city bus stopped beside the museum at noon.
At midday, public transit halted next to the art and history building.
The bicycle mechanic replaced a damaged rear wheel.
A repair worker fitted a new back wheel to the bike.
The delivery van turned left after the stone bridge.
Once past the masonry crossing, the courier vehicle took the road to its left.
The baker mixed flour with warm water before kneading.
Before working the dough, the bread maker combined heated water and flour.
The chef roasted carrots for twenty minutes in the oven.
The cook left orange root vegetables baking for a third of an hour.
A saucepan of tomato soup simmered on the stove.
The red vegetable broth bubbled gently in a small pot over the burner.
The cook added lemon juice after removing the fish from heat.
Only after taking the seafood off the burner did the chef squeeze citrus onto it.
The pastry cooled on a wire rack beside the window.
A baked sweet rested until cold on a metal grid near the glass.
The telescope detected a faint galaxy beyond the cluster.
An optical instrument spotted a dim distant star system past the group.
The moon rose above the western ridge just after sunset.
Shortly following dusk, Earth's satellite appeared over the hills to the west.
An observatory recorded a meteor during the midnight watch.
While monitoring the sky at twelve at night, astronomers logged a shooting star.
The comet passed closest to the sun in early March.
At the start of the third month, the icy visitor reached perihelion.
The planet completed one orbit in nearly two hundred days.
A full revolution around its star took the world about 200 days.
The gardener watered the seedlings before sunrise.
Young plants received irrigation from the grower ahead of dawn.
A small greenhouse protected the tomatoes from cold wind.
The red fruit plants were sheltered from chilly gusts inside a glass growing house.
The oak sapling was planted beside the wooden fence.
A young oak tree went into the soil next to the timber boundary.
The gardener removed weeds after the afternoon rain.
Following the later shower, the groundskeeper pulled unwanted plants.
The rose bush produced three flowers in late spring.
Near the end of the blooming season, three blossoms opened on the thorny shrub.
The accountant reviewed the quarterly budget on Friday.
At the week's end, the bookkeeper checked spending plans for the three-month period.
A local bank approved the small business loan.
The neighborhood lender accepted a modest credit request from a company.
The store lowered prices after inventory increased.
Once stock levels rose, the shop reduced what customers had to pay.
The investor sold half the shares before the market closed.
Prior to the exchange's final bell, the trader disposed of fifty percent of the holdings.
The company reported a profit despite rising energy costs.
Even with power expenses increasing, the firm announced positive earnings.
The goalkeeper blocked a penalty in the final minute.
At the very end, the player guarding the net stopped a spot kick.
The runner completed five laps before taking a break.
The athlete circled the track five times and then rested.
The referee paused the match because of heavy rain.
Intense rainfall led the official to suspend the game temporarily.
The cyclist crossed the finish line two seconds ahead.
The bike racer ended the course with a lead of only a couple of seconds.
The coach substituted a defender after halftime.
Following the interval, the team manager replaced one of the back-line players.
The violinist rehearsed in the empty concert hall.
A musician practiced violin alone inside the vacant auditorium.
The drummer replaced a broken cymbal before the show.
Prior to the performance, the percussionist swapped out a cracked cymbal.
The choir sang softly during the evening rehearsal.
At dusk practice, the vocal ensemble performed in quiet voices.
The pianist played a minor chord on the old keyboard.
On the aging piano, the player sounded a chord in a minor key.
The guitarist tuned the lowest string after the encore.
Following the final extra song, the player adjusted the guitar's deepest-pitched string.
A cold front brought rain to the coastal town overnight.
During the night, wet weather reached the seaside community as cooler air moved in.
The afternoon forecast warned of hail near the valley.
Meteorologists expected ice pellets around the lowland later that day.
Morning fog covered the airport runway until nine.
The airfield landing strip stayed hidden by mist before 9 a.m.
The wind shifted west as the storm passed the hills.
After the tempest moved beyond the ridges, breezes began blowing from the west.
A heatwave raised the city temperature above forty degrees.
The urban area exceeded 40 degrees during an extended spell of extreme warmth.
